implemented_requirements.requirement: Two-player paddles, each controlled by a different set of keys
implemented_requirements.evidence: paddle.py defines class Paddle with up_key and down_key parameters; Game.__init__ creates left_paddle with keys K_w/K_s and right_paddle with K_UP/K_DOWN.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Paddles move vertically up and down and are clamped within the screen
implemented_requirements.evidence: Paddle.move() updates y based on pressed keys and then calls clamp(); clamp() limits y to 0 and SCREEN_HEIGHT - height (paddle.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off the top and bottom edges
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_wall_collisions() detects ball_rect.top <= 0 or ball_rect.bottom >= SCREEN_HEIGHT and calls ball.bounce_vertical() (ball.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball bounces off both paddles with angle adjustment and speed increase
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_paddle_collisions() detects collision and calls ball.bounce_horizontal(paddle); bounce_horizontal() flips speed_x, calls adjust_angle() and increase_speed() (ball.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Scoring when a player misses the ball
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.check_scoring() checks if ball_rect.right < 0 or ball_rect.left > SCREEN_WIDTH and increments the opposite paddle's score (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Winning score threshold and win detection
implemented_requirements.evidence: settings.WINNING_SCORE = 5; after_point() compares paddle scores to WINNING_SCORE and sets self.winner accordingly (game.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ball reset after each point (unless the game is over)
implemented_requirements.evidence: after_point() calls self.ball.reset() when no winner yet; Ball.reset() places the ball at the centre with a new direction (ball.py).

implemented_requirements.requirement: Ability to restart after a win and quit the game
implemented_requirements.evidence: Game.handle_events() listens for SPACE to call restart() when a winner exists, and ESC or window close to quit (game.py).

judge.summary: The provided source files implement a complete two‑player Pong game: paddles are controllable, the ball correctly bounces off paddles and walls, scoring, win detection, ball reset, and restart/quit controls are all present. The code is coherent and, assuming pygame is installed, should run without modification. No major missing functionality or fatal bugs were found.
